canonical_initial_center: repeat observable current_action over all 8 knots
direction_basis: 32 directions = unnormalized Sylvester Hadamard-16 plus RMS-normalized orthonormal DCT-II-16; evaluate antithetic signs
selection: At each stage choose the first argmin over the retained incumbent followed by that stage's 64 candidates; only the resulting canonical incumbent seeds the next stage.
old_teacher_usage: Stored warm/T0/fullrank centers and costs are comparison-only and can never enter canonical candidate construction or canonical argmin.
nearest_neighbor_contract: Nested five-fold: outer query fold, (fold+1)%5 excluded for inner selection, remaining 60 episode-disjoint rows form the fit bank; fit-only robust normalization of strict observable blocks.

routing.all_gates_pass: Train the small nested-OOF strict no-anchor Actor audit before any full teacher generation.
routing.search_quality_only_fails: Revise only the canonical search budget/geometry; do not train Actor.
routing.coherence_or_transfer_fails: Reject this canonicalization and do not scale teacher generation.
